entities.name: Ismet Bajramović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ismet "Ćelo" Bajramović was a Bosnian soldier and reputed organized crime figure from Sarajevo. During the war in Bosnia and Herzegovina and specifically the siege of Sarajevo, Bajramović was one of the gangsters who played a key role in the defense of the city in the early days of the war.
